entries.hadith: The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.
entries.theme: Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity

entries.hadith: Make things easy and do not make them difficult; give glad tidings and do not repel people.
The example of the one who remembers his Lord and the one who does not is like the living and the dead.
entries.theme: Hearts find rest in the remembrance of Allah

entries.hadith: Purity is half of faith, and Alhamdulillah fills the scale.
entries.theme: Do not lose heart or grieve — you will be superior if you are believers

entries.hadith: If you relied upon Allah with true reliance, He would provide for you as He provides for the birds.
entries.theme: Whoever relies on Allah — He is sufficient for him
Call upon Me, I will respond to you

entries.hadith: The most beloved deeds to Allah are those done most consistently, even if small.
entries.theme: Which of your Lord's favours will you deny?

note: Curated starter set for the daily rotation. Ayah/Hadith of the Day (report Module 4). Hadith texts are well-known, from Sahih al-Bukhari / Sahih Muslim / Riyadh as-Saliheen; references given per entry. Expand this list over time; rotation is by day-of-year modulo list length.
